## Goal

Complete the TradeGrid contribution workflow for the first time.

## Task

Create:

```text
contributors/<your-github-username>.md
```

Follow the template in `contributors/README.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Contributor file uses your GitHub username as the filename
- [ ] Name is included
- [ ] GitHub username is included
- [ ] Major / year is included
- [ ] Areas of interest are included
- [ ] What you want to learn is included
- [ ] A pull request is opened and links this issue

## Difficulty

Starter

## Area

Documentation / onboarding
